title: Fourier restriction norm method adapted to controlled paths: stochastic wave equations
summary: We investigate the pathwise well-posedness issue of the stochastic nonlinear wave equation (SNLW) with a multiplicative noise. While the Ito solution theory (= random field solution theory) was established in the '80s, its pathwise well-posedness has remained a challenging open problem for over forty years. By building a unified framework for the Fourier restriction norm method adapted to the $U^p$- and $V^p$-spaces, due to Koch and Tataru (2007), and the Young/rough integration theory via the sewing lemma and controlled paths due to Gubinelli (2004) along with the random tensor estimate for…
